claims.text: Pre-trained language models can be leveraged as embedding models combined with machine learning models to predict supply chain relationships within knowledge graphs.
Integrating Generative AI techniques into supply chain link prediction captures nuanced semantic relationships between entities.

evidence.description: In this work, we develop a new Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) enhanced machine learning framework that leverages pre-trained language models as embedding models combined with machine learning models to predict supply chain relationships within knowledge graphs.

By integrating Generative AI techniques, our approach captures the nuanced semantic relationships between entities, thereby improving supply chain visibility and facilitating more precise risk management.

methodologies.name: GenAI-enhanced link prediction framework
methodologies.description: A machine learning framework leveraging pre-trained language models as embedding models combined with machine learning classifiers to predict supply chain relationships in knowledge graphs.

limitations.text: Existing relationship prediction methods struggle to extract the context in which relationships are embedded, such as products being supplied or locations they are supplied from.
